Name: FS - Roley's moth antennas
Author: Roleymoth
Description:
[b][color=#d5a6bd]ABOUT[/color][/b]
This mods adds your game 10 different moth antennas for your farmer. Antennas can be selected with the [u][b]hand mirror[/b][/u] from the fashion sense mod, this is bought from Pierres or Haley left in your mailbox 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dRt6lC5.png[/img]

[b][color=#9fc5e8]Installation instructions[/color][/b]
You get RAR file > Extract files > drop file in stardew valley's mod folder.

[b][color=#93c47d]Requirements[/color][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] are required for this mod to work
